sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid materials and the nature of the dispute, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary.

Signed By :
TANMOY NANDAN High Court of Calcutta 4 th of October 2024 10:24:12 AM 4.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, namely, Md. Zahid shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.2,000/-, with one surety, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.
5. It is further directed that the present accused petitioner shall appear before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Asansol by 8th October, 2024.
6. The report is kept with the record.
7. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is disposed of.
8. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.) Signed By :
TANMOY NANDAN High Court of Calcutta 4 th of October 2024 10:24:12 AM Md. Zahid vs Unknown
